_comment: Cron/dispatch-only workflows that have never run and CANNOT be run yet.
`workflow_dispatch` resolves the workflow file on the DEFAULT branch, so a
workflow being added answers 404 to `gh workflow run --ref <branch>` until
it merges. check_cron_workflow_freshness.py would otherwise be
unsatisfiable before the merge and red on main straight after it.
An entry is a dispatch OWED, not an exemption. The checker reads this file
both ways: a workflow with no history and no entry still fails, and an
entry whose workflow has since acquired run history fails too, naming the
entry to delete. Record `exit_when` as the command that retires it.

bootstrap.why: Added by this change. Nothing has executed it, and nothing can: dispatch resolves the file on main, where it does not exist until this merges.
bootstrap.exit_when: gh workflow run dependabot-rebase.yml  (once it is on main), then delete this entry
